comments.author: Donce
comments.body:
These gloves have Search+1 and Throwing+1.
They can be plundered from NPC Poacher Lv31 in land battle in Tacoma Outskirts.
This NPC spawns in two spots in the northwest corner of the map.

comments.author: V_I
comments.body:
There's a screenshot of the exact survey map locations here: tinyurl.com/UWO-PioneerRecordMA

I wish the other NPCs you need to track down had more than one spawn site you could hunt them at. And that they were by such a nifty looking beach.

comments.author: Donce
comments.body: confirmed, you can plunder these gloves in North America West Coast too. Best spot is in the top part of the map, near Upturned Boulder - 4 poachers spawn there close to each other.
